title: Lipoprotein Lipase Activity Assay
author: Abcam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iy3cfyn
materials: Equilibrate all materials and prepared reagents to room temperature prior to use We recommend that you assay all standards, controls and samples in duplicate Set up Reaction Wells Standard wells = 50 μL standard dilutions. Sample wells = 1 – 50 μL samples (adjust volume to 50 μL/well with ddH2O). Background Control wells= 50 μL ddH2O. Positive Control wells = 4 μL diluted positive control (section 12.1) + 46 μL ddH2O. Assay Control wells = 4 μL diluted positive control (section 12.1) + 2 μL Inhibitor + 44 μL ddH2O.

steps.title: Collect Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare plasma from mouse or rat to measure maximum LPL activity.

substeps.instruction: Inject mouse/rat with 0.2 Units heparin/gram of body weight via tail vein injection.
Centrifuge samples at 3000 x g for 15 min at 4°C using a cold microcentrifuge.
Collect supernatant and transfer to a clean tube.
Use 1-10 μL/well for the assay as initially recommended.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix of the Reaction Mix to ensure consistency for all standard reactions.

substeps.instruction: Calculate required volumes using: X μL component x (Number reactions + 1).
Prepare 50 μL of Reaction Mix for each standard reaction.

steps.title: Set Up Assay Plate
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the plate and prepare for incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μL of Reaction Mix into each standard well and mix well.
Add 50 μL of diluted Substrate into each sample, Positive Control, and assay validation well and mix well.

steps.title: Incubate and Measure Activity
steps.instruction: Stabilize the signal and measure fluorescence in kinetic mode.

substeps.instruction: Pre-incubate the plate at 37°C for 10 minutes, protected from light.
Measure output at Ex/Em = 482/515 nm on a microplate reader in kinetic mode every 10 minutes for at least 1 hour at 37°C, protected from light.
Select two time points (T1 and T2) in the linear range to calculate LPL activity.
Read the Standard Curve in end point mode at the end of the incubation time.
Ensure RFU value at T2 does not exceed the highest RFU in the standard curve.
Do not subtract RFU1 from RFU2 for the standard curve.

steps.title: Analyze and Dilute Samples
steps.instruction: Process samples that exceed the standard curve range.

substeps.instruction: Dilute samples producing signals greater than the highest standard in appropriate buffer and reanalyze.
Multiply the resulting concentration by the appropriate dilution factor.
Use the linear portion of the kinetic reading when calculating enzymatic activity.
